reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The system mechanism involves using a few-mode fiber (FMF) to provide joint communications and sensing. The FMF is made sensitive by analyzing the higher-order modes excited by the inter-modal crosstalk (IMXT) introduced by the mode multiplexer/demultiplexer (MUX/DEMUX) pair. The IMXT allows the higher-order modes to be excited by the fundamental mode transporting the TLC signal, enabling the detection of perturbations affecting the FMF.

reasoning_trace.description: Identify the solved problems and remaining open challenges.
reasoning_trace.value: The paper solves the problem of providing joint communications and sensing in FMFs by exploiting the IMXT generated by the fundamental mode transporting the TLC signal. However, open challenges remain, such as scaling up the system to longer distances and exploring the use of other types of fibers and sensing applications.
